Starting the Battle Tutorial.
First, an explanation of the Hero Gauge.
Attacking enemies in battle, or being attacked by them, fills the Hero Gauge.
You can store multiple Hero Gauges. Spend 1 to raise a skill's level by 1,
or spend 3 to use a HERO Skill.
Next, an explanation of the Color Timer for Ultraman-type heroes.
Ultraman-type heroes have a Color Timer shown in their status.
The Color Timer changes color every 3 turns. While blue, the Ultra's true power is at full strength,
but when it turns red, stats drop sharply in exchange for a much higher critical rate.
After 3 more turns as red, or when the battle ends, it returns to blue.
With an Ultraman-type hero in the party, keep an eye on the Color Timer as you fight.
That concludes the Battle Tutorial.
Select "Skill Tree" in the Camp Menu, then spend AP
along the tree to power up or learn skills and HERO Skills.
However, Crossover Skills are used by spending 2 gauges at a time.
Starting the Chip Tutorial.
Defeated enemies may drop chips. These chips are useless as they are.
You must run the "Chip Report" command from the Briefing Room menu at the base.
The analyzed chip data may teach you a "Force".
Each character can equip multiple Forces up to their capacity,
but a Force that is already equipped cannot be equipped by another character.
There are 2 kinds of Forces: command-use and automatic-effect.
Collect chips and learn all sorts of Forces to help you through the game.
That concludes the Chip Tutorial.
You need to run the Chip Report command.
